ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement: An ethics self-assessment is completed as an integral part of this proposal, as required by the Tier 1 extracted rule ethics_self_assessment_required; projects with ethics issues may undergo ethics review and resulting ethics requirements may become contractual obligations (implementation_constraints.json). The action focuses exclusively on civil applications and does not involve any of the excluded activities (human cloning for reproductive purposes, heritable-genome modification, or creation/destruction of human embryos), consistent with the Tier 1 civil_focus_constraint. Two ethics dimensions are identified from the project scope and flagged for the self-assessment: (1) the development and deployment of AI/ML-based predictive systems (the FIELDWISE predictive engine in WP3 and the DrR web MVP in WP5), and (2) potential processing of personal or commercially sensitive data during AgroVIR farmer-field validation in WP5. Regarding ethics review: the Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records ethics_review_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source path cites an ethics review as a topic-specific mandate for this call, so this is treated as a Tier 3 derivative flag pending call-specific confirmation rather than a confirmed call mandate. Regarding the gender dimension: integration of the gender dimension in research and innovation content follows the Tier 1 default rule that it is mandatory unless the topic explicitly states non-relevance. No Tier 2B exemption source is currently cited in this Phase 6 artifact; Phase 8 drafting must either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation. Regarding gender equality at the organisational level, beneficiaries must promote equal opportunities and aim for gender balance at all levels of personnel, and public bodies, research organisations and higher education establishments in Member States/Associated Countries must hold a gender equality plan at grant signature (Tier 1 gender_equality_plan_eligibility, gender_management_balance_guidance); the Tier 3 compliance_profile.json separately records gender_plan_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding.
